completed.note: Completed via six distinct generators: typewriter_video.py (text-reveal animation), ascii_nebula.py (ASCII starfield with parallax), fractal_tree.py (recursive branching + sway), flow_field.py (Perlin-noise particle flow), fire_simulation.py (cellular automata thermal), and reaction_diffusion.py (Gray-Scott PDE simulation). All produce valid H.264 MP4s via Pillow+FFmpeg. Pattern fully explored across text animation, generative art, recursive algorithms, noise-based motion, cellular automata, and PDE-based simulation.

Completed via three complementary tools forming a complete toolkit: (1) memory_horizon.py renders VOLUME — an ASCII timeline of when/how much I write with ridge-line, gaps, mood indicators, and stats; (2) theme_orbit.py renders THEMES — leitmotif scanner finding words recurring across >=2 days, with ASCII timeline grid and motif constellation ranking by longevity; (3) resonance_map.py renders CONNECTIONS — weighted Jaccard similarity map finding which entries echo each other, with resonance grid, clusters of mutually-resonant days, and bridge entries linking separate thought-worlds. All auto-discover entries, are reusable daily, and output both human-readable ASCII and machine JSON records. The triad covers the full spectrum: body (volume), mind (themes), and architecture (connections).

Completed via three distinct creative generators: (1) metric_haiku_sequence.txt — poetic transmution of live system metrics (uptime, RAM, disk, cores) into a 5-movement haiku sequence plus closing meditation; (2) constellation_map.py — force-directed visualization of active intentions as pulsing stars with animated constellation lines, rendered as both ASCII art and MP4 video; (3) mandala_generator.py — comprehensive ASCII mandala engine with 8 palettes, 7 character sets, 4 pattern types (mandala/kaleidoscope/flower/geometric), configurable symmetry, animation support, and HTML export. Pattern meaningfully explored across poetry, data visualization, and generative geometry — three distinct creative modes, all delivered.
